statements.impact_statement: Waiting for upstream Linux-PAM to ship a constant-time fix for the pam_userdb plaintext-password timing leak (Debian security tracker marks [trixie] as postponed, minor issue; no fix available in any Debian release). The vulnerable path requires pam_userdb to be configured with crypt=none or no crypt= argument, which DHI images do not configure. This pam package is present only in dev images that include apt tooling; runtime images are not affected by this package-level finding.
